title: Havells Carina UV Water Purifier
subtitle: 100 % UV + UF Purification
category: Home Appliances > Water Purifiers > UV Water Purifiers
key_features: Futuristic Design : Featuring a classy design
Best in class Purification Technology : Assured Safe & Healthy Water
Double Protection : UV & UF Technology gives the benefit of double purification by removing disease causing micro organisms like bacteria, virus & cyst.
System monitors the UV dose for optimum performance always. In the event of intensity dropping below specified level, the system shuts off the flow of water
Purification through Germicidal UV Lamp an optimum exposure of water to UV-C radiation makes water free from microbiological threats like pathogenic bacteria & viruses.
i Protect Purification Monitoring : Constantly monitors the purification process, and ensures safe water.
Electrical Protection System : Advanced Electronics ensure purifier performs well in the voltage range of 150 V - 250 V. Protects your purifier from voltage fluctuations
Smart indications & error alerts : Power, Purification, Tank full indications & UV Error alert
Easy to dispense, zero splash, soft touch switch to dispense water and no secondary contamination.
Installation & Warranty : Experience best in class care 360 service & manufacturers warranty cover for 1 year standard warranty . T&C apply. Refer to user manual
